title: fix(types): AnySchema includes every declared node type, pinned by an enumeration (objectui#11478)
body:
Fixes #11478

Clause-②: yes

## What changed

`AnySchema` in `packages/types/src/index.ts` now includes the eighteen node types its docblock claimed but did not hold. The new members follow the module order of the barrel's exports:

- After `DashboardComponentSchema`: `DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema` (`metric-card`, `complex.ts`). It is named only in the union; its own shape is untouched (objectui#11467 edits that interface).
- After `ListViewSchema`: the six designer schemas (`PageDesignerSchema`, `DataModelDesignerSchema`, `ProcessDesignerSchema`, `ReportDesignerSchema`, `ObjectManagerSchema`, `FieldDesignerSchema`), then the three report schemas (`ReportComponentSchema`, `ReportBuilderSchema`, `ReportViewerSchema`), then the three AI schemas (`AIFormAssistSchema`, `AIRecommendationsSchema`, `NLQuerySchema`).
- Next comes `ViewComponentSchema`. This existing union in `views.ts` holds `DetailViewSchema`, `ViewSwitcherSchema`, `FilterUISchema` and `SortUISchema`. Using it adds no second list, and the zod twin `AnyComponentSchema` arms the same group.
- Last is `ActionBarSchema` (`action:bar`, `ui-action.ts`).

The `BaseSchema` arm stays. No interface's own shape changes, and no new type is added. The docblock now points at the pin (AGENTS.md #9) instead of stating a count. The only other edit is the `import type` lines the union needs. The emitted JS of `index.ts` is byte-identical: `ts.transpileModule` of the base and head versions gives 5176 bytes each, and the outputs are equal.

## Accept set: before and after

I measured this with a compiler-API probe, run against the package's own `tsconfig.json`. It ran at base `2c0ddf226` and at head `50714a6d`. For each of the eighteen node types, with LIT standing for its `type` literal:

| case, assigned to `AnySchema` | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| a value typed as the interface itself | OK | OK |
| bare `{ type: LIT }` | OK | OK |
| `{ type: LIT, zzUnknownKey: 1 }` | OK | OK |
| `{ type: LIT, OWNKEY: Symbol('x') }`: a wrong value on the first key the interface declares and `BaseSchema` does not | OK | OK |
| `{ type: LIT, visible: 42 }`: a wrong value on a `BaseSchema` key | TS2322 | TS2322, same message |
| `SchemaByType` of LIT is the interface | false | true |
| `SchemaByType` of LIT is `never` | true | false |

The two controls behave the same at base and head. An undeclared `type` with an unknown key is OK, and `button` with `visible: 42` is TS2322.

The 92 value verdicts are identical, and so is every diagnostic message. Only the 36 `SchemaByType` readings flip. So this changes no accept set; it changes what `SchemaByType` and narrowing on `type` return. A wrong value on an interface-only key still compiles because TypeScript tries every member of the union, and the `BaseSchema` arm, with its string index signature, still takes the literal. That is the arm objectui#11466 is about, and this PR leaves it alone.

## The pin: `anyschema-declared-node-types-11478.test.ts`

The pin builds one compiler program over the package's own sources with its own `tsconfig.json`, so it does not depend on `dist/`. The program covers the root barrel, every published subpath entry (read from `package.json` `exports`), and one virtual module that is never written to disk. It has five cases:

1. **Control.** The enumerator runs over the virtual module and flags exactly the two node types that are outside the control union: one that extends `BaseSchema` directly, and one that extends a key-remapping omit of `ButtonSchema`, spelled the way `form.ts` spells `OmitDeclared`. It does not flag the one inside the union, a standalone interface, or a `BaseSchema` child whose `type` is a plain string.
2. The population read from the real barrel is not empty and contains `ButtonSchema`.
3. **Completeness.** Every exported, non-generic, non-union object type that has a literal `type` and whose `extends` chain reaches `BaseSchema` is a member of `AnySchema`. On failure it prints each missing name with its literal and file.
4. `ActionBarSchema` is a member by name. It is also asserted to be outside the population; if that ever goes red, the type has started extending `BaseSchema` and the by-name case should be deleted.
5. **Round-trip.** `SchemaByType` resolves every single-literal member of `AnySchema` to that member. This is a distributive conditional over the real union, evaluated by the checker, with no list.

**Ablations.** The fix was committed first. Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, plus a shell trap. After each one, the restore was proven: the blob equals the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No build is involved, because the pin reads `src/` through its own program, with no package `exports` resolution and no vitest alias.

- `index.ts` at base, against the pin: 2 failed and 3 passed. The output names the seventeen node types with their files and literals, plus the by-name `ActionBarSchema` case.
- Deleting `| ViewComponentSchema`: case 3 fails and names `DetailViewSchema`, `FilterUISchema`, `SortUISchema` and `ViewSwitcherSchema`.
- Removing `| ActionBarSchema`: case 4 fails.
- Adding `| (BaseSchema & { type: 'button' })`: case 5 fails and names `ButtonSchema` and the new arm.
- My first attempt at the `ViewComponentSchema` leg ran nothing. The tool refused it because the replacement text was a substring of the anchor, so its count went 1 to 1. I reran it as a `--delete`.

## The card's hypotheses, measured

- **H1 holds.** The heritage enumeration finds the same seventeen at `6007dd4e4` and at `2c0ddf226`, after objectui#11477; no interface was added or removed. I compared three criteria, and only heritage matches the card's population:
  - Heritage, the pin's criterion: 116 at the root barrel, and exactly the seventeen are outside the union.
  - Plain assignability to `BaseSchema` catches about a hundred more types with a literal `type` that are not node types (field metadata, query-AST nodes, widget sources), so it is not usable.
  - Carrying all of `BaseSchema`'s named members picks up the spec-row `AuthoringNode` faces: `ElementTextInputNode`, `ElementRecordPickerNode`, and since objectui#11477 also `FlexBlockNode` and the eight object-* block nodes. Those belong to `AuthoringNode`. Their literals overlap this union's (`flex`, `object-grid` and others), and the heritage criterion keeps them out, so they are not counted twice.
  - Following the first type argument of a utility type in an `extends` clause adds `InputShorthandSchema` and `UiCalendarSchema` to the population. Both were already members.
  - `ActionBarSchema` is confirmed standalone. The four app-shell hand-offs type it as `ActionBarSchema`: two in `EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx`, one in `InterfaceListPage.tsx` and one in `ObjectView.tsx`. The `action:bar` renderer in components takes it as its `schema`.
- **H2: no collisions.** None of the eighteen literals is already declared by a literal member of `AnySchema`, and none collides with another of the eighteen. After the change, `SchemaByType` of each one resolves to that interface alone. Case 5 checks this property over the whole union.
- **H3: a pin is possible without a new gate.** It is a runtime test in `packages/types/src/__tests__/`. Its one stated blind spot: a future standalone node type like `ActionBarSchema` that does not extend `BaseSchema`. The pin's header and `AnySchema`'s docblock both say so.

## Every consumer and document re-checked

- **In-repo readers of `AnySchema` / `SchemaByType`.** A `git grep` over all tracked files finds none outside `index.ts`. The only other hits are `packages/types/README.md` and three historical `.changeset` bodies. So no package's compile can move, and the downstream sweep of `@object-ui/types` dependents was not run (a declared narrowing). CI runs the full type-check.
- **`packages/types/README.md`.** Both blocks that use `AnySchema` (Type Narrowing, and the slice assignment with a `switch`) compile under `check:doc-snippets` against the rebuilt `dist`.
- **Pending changesets that name `index.ts`.** `check:changeset-claims` lists `6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md` and `component-meta-converge-and-deprecate-alias-5893.md`. I read both. They cover `GanttConfig` and `PluginComponentMeta`, which this diff does not touch.

## Overlap with objectui#11477

objectui#11477 merged as `2c0ddf226` and edits the `AuthoringNode` export list in the same file. Before the first commit, my branch was fast-forwarded to it, so there was no merge commit and no conflict. Everything above was measured on that tree. That PR covers nothing this one adds.

## Gates, all at head `50714a6d`

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check`: exit 0. The script echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. The new test file is in the test program (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/anyschema-declared-node-types-11478.test.ts`: 5 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/`: Test Files 334 passed (334), Tests 8789 passed (8789).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`: dist completeness complete (144 emitted files). The doc-snippets scoped build: 35 of 35 tasks successful.
- `pnpm check:doc-snippets`: exit 0, "Semantic phase: 776 of 776 block(s) judged, 0 failed."
- `pnpm check:doc-examples`: exit 0. `pnpm check:doc-types`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- `check:changeset-claims` (report-only), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `type-check:coverage`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:readme-exports` and `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only): all exit 0.
- `check:sdui-registration-pins`: NOT MEASURED. It exits 2 because the console bundle is not built. It is not reached by this diff, since the emitted JS is unchanged.
- **eslint, narrowed to the two touched `.ts` files.** 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 118 rules in effect on the test file. `--print-config` shows no `parserOptions.project`, so linting is not type-aware, and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide lint is CI's.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `SchemaByType` of a literal whose member declares a union of literals is `never`, because `Extract` asks whether the whole `type` fits the one literal. Measured at head: `email` (`InputShorthandSchema`, which also declares `password`), `header` (`SemanticElementSchema`) and `h1` (`HtmlElementSchema`). The `button` control resolves. This predates the PR, has no in-repo reader, and case 5 skips these members by design.
- The zod twin refuses `{ type: 'action:bar' }` and `{ type: 'metric-card' }` at the top level (`safeValidateSchema` returns "Invalid input"), while it accepts `detail-view`, `report` and `nl-query`. The TS face already admitted both through the `BaseSchema` arm, so this is not new. No stored producer of either literal was found: the `action:bar` nodes are built in app-shell code, and `metric-card` is a widget-slot type.
- `packages/types/README.md` says the shipped `AnySchema` "carries 50+ members". That is a prose count (AGENTS.md #9), and it is still true. It is outside this card's file surface.
- `SemanticElementSchema` and `HtmlElementSchema` are members of `AnySchema` but are exported only from the `./layout` subpath, not from the root barrel. The pin reads the subpath entries for this reason.

The slot union, `CustomNodeRegistry`, and the `app` / `list` discriminant collisions stay with objectui#11466.
